clips.title: The story
paras: Cookie tends the crew's cauldrons aboard the juggernaut deep in the Deadmines. A murloc among the Defias Brotherhood, he cooks beneath the watch of Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef. In the underground dry dock, he is the only entirely optional boss.

Cookie cooks beneath the decks of the towering juggernaut in Ironclad Cove. No human outrider or goblin engineer takes the duty; the solitary murloc does. How Cookie came to hold the position is unknown. The rest of the crew may doubt a murloc's cooking, but pirates rarely choose their meals with care. In Moonbrook's underworld, a meal is a meal.

Cookie patrols the waterways and shores around the pirate flagship. He wields cooking utensils and throws acidic brews. Though apart from typical murloc tribes, he defends his cauldron with savage force, flinging caustic mixtures at intruders who enter the docks. His station lies away from the main gangplanks, so many who storm the cove pass his kitchen by. Cookie is the only overseer aboard the Defias juggernaut who can be bypassed.
